definitions.explanation: Two years from the current year.

examples.japanese: {再来年|さらいねん}、{大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}します。
examples.english: I'll graduate from university the year after next.

examples.japanese: オリンピックは{再来年|さらいねん}だ。
examples.english: The Olympics are the year after next.

notes: Time reference sequence: {去年|きょねん}/{昨年|さくねん} (last year) → {今年|ことし} (this year) → {来年|らいねん} (next year) → {再来年|さらいねん} (year after next).
